tasks.subject: Task 14: Pipeline dry-runs — GATE
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove each pipeline works end-to-end before any schedule exists.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:** none permanent — produces three real PRs or three recorded no-op runs.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Per agent: a fresh session given ONLY the Task-15 routine prompt either opened a correct update PR with green CI, or correctly exited silently with no newer release — evidence captured
- Failures fixed by amending PIPELINE.md/sources.json/AGENTS.md (rules live in-repo) and re-run to pass
- Any produced PR reviewed row-by-row against the release notes it claims to apply, then merged or deliberately closed

**Verify:** gh pr list --repo dommango/agent-placemats --state all --search "update placemat" shows the dry-run PRs (or no-op transcripts captured for all three).

```json:metadata
{"userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "files": [], "verifyCommand": "gh pr list --repo dommango/agent-placemats --state all --search 'update placemat'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["codex dry-run PR or verified no-op with evidence", "kimi dry-run PR or verified no-op with evidence", "hermes dry-run PR or verified no-op with evidence", "fixes folded into in-repo rules"], "requireEvidenceTokens": [["codex"], ["kimi"], ["hermes"]]}
```
